# Phillips

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- **Titles:** Mr.  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Personality

Mr. Phillips maintains scandalous order in his schoolroom, often failing to keep control despite frequently whipping his students. He heavily favors his older pupils while neglecting the younger ones, and he displays a solemn, condescending attitude toward his students' mistakes.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## Traits

- unable to maintain order  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>
- favors older students  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- frequently uses corporal punishment  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)</sub>

## Goals

- preparing older students for Queen's  <sub>[v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Phillips served as the schoolmaster in Avonlea, boarding at Eben Wright's house near the schoolhouse. During his time teaching, he frequently spent his attention on the older students preparing for Queen's, such as Prissy Andrews, while neglecting the younger scholars. His lack of strict discipline led to poor room order and frequent punishments, including whipping Sam Boulter—which led to an altercation with Sam's father—and publicly mortifying and punishing Anne Shirley. During a Mayflower picking outing, he gave all the flowers he found to Prissy Andrews, quoting poetry to her.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P56](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0056), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 c20 P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_
